title: fix: make release validation failures diagnosable
body:
Related: #197510

## What Problem This Solves

Release validation can fail before reaching the scenario, discard useful memory observations when one endpoint is unavailable, or omit which Telegram startup phase failed. Two admission fixtures also simulate a foreign schema mutation after ownership has already been admitted rather than testing rejection of an incompatible replacement.

## User Impact

This improves developer and release-operator diagnostics and makes nested-checkout worker builds select their own dependency files. It does not relax release acceptance, change database admission policy, or alter Telegram authorization, retry, or timeout behavior. No configuration or dependency changes.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Resolve worker dependency entries against the owning checkout instead of treating bare `node_modules` paths as package specifiers.
- Preserve independent RSS endpoints and samples while keeping derived comparisons and release validation strict. Report bounded, payload-free sampling failures.
- Exercise incompatible database replacements before admission in both synchronous and asynchronous fixtures.
- Retain Telegram startup phase, fixed primary/participant role, request outcome, and connection-state diagnostics without targets, messages, or credentials.

## Evidence

Combined-head verification passed: 188 tests across eight focused TypeScript files, the worker-dependency build regression (1 passed, 68 filtered), 48 Python tests, typed lint for all touched TypeScript, state/logging and QA test typechecks, the tooling test typecheck, formatting, and whitespace checks. Original red/green evidence is retained for worker entry resolution, RSS endpoint preservation, database replacement admission on the release baseline, and missing Telegram phase/role diagnostics. An isolated patched-candidate mock Gateway scenario passed with all four RSS samples; the unchanged collaborator scenario passed all 15 inference turns after local browser/proxy setup corrections. These are not claims that the original CI timeout or OS sampling cause is fixed.

No live Telegram operation was performed. An unchanged relocated fs-safe worker fixture fails on this host because its writable temporary ancestor selects the secure fallback; the same signature was reproduced on the unmodified main owner. No assertion or security safeguard was weakened.

Autoreview and ClawSweeper were explicitly excluded by the release owner. Fresh independent source inspection and targeted verification are used; enforced repository checks remain required.

Full `pnpm build` stopped in the unchanged AI declaration phase: OpenAI 7.47.0 explicitly imports parent `node_modules` paths and finds the enclosing checkout’s Undici 8.12.3 despite the owned frozen install containing Undici 8.12.4. The declaration boundary correctly rejects that external input. This is a local nested-checkout build limitation, not a successful full-build result; no dependency/compiler-boundary changes are included. A diagnostic broad package type trace also reported unrelated package-fixture/config errors; the scoped required typechecks above passed.
